default.risk_reason: No rule-specific auto-fix policy is configured.

nullPointer.risk_reason: Null pointer fixes can change control flow.

uninitvar.risk_reason: Initialization fixes can change runtime behavior.

misra-c2012-8.9.risk_reason: Scope changes can affect linkage and visibility.

misra-c2012-17.7.risk_reason: Return-value handling can change error handling semantics.

patterns.risk_reason: Volatile-related changes may affect hardware or concurrency semantics.
patterns.$comment: volatile 关键字涉及硬件寄存器或并发场景，编译器优化行为不可预测，需人工确认

patterns.risk_reason: Interrupt path changes need manual timing and safety review.
patterns.$comment: 中断处理涉及实时性和上下文保存，自动修复可能引入竞态条件或时序问题

patterns.risk_reason: Register access changes may affect hardware behavior.
patterns.$comment: 寄存器访问通常与硬件地址绑定，修改可能影响外设配置或内存映射

patterns.risk_reason: AUTOSAR RTE paths require integration review.
patterns.$comment: AUTOSAR RTE 接口由工具生成，修改可能破坏 SWC 与 BSW 的通信契约

patterns.risk_reason: MCAL paths can affect hardware abstraction behavior.
patterns.$comment: MCAL 为微控制器抽象层，修改需确认硬件规格和驱动配置一致性

patterns.risk_reason: CAN interface changes need communication stack review.
patterns.$comment: CAN 接口修改涉及总线通信协议，需确认帧格式、时序和诊断行为
